risks.text: Market demand for a paid bilingual template pack is unclear, as no clear demand signals were found in the interviews.
Competitors like Notion and Google Sheets offer free or low-cost solutions that may undermine the value proposition of the paid template pack.
The founder's assumption that freelance designers will pay USD 100 for a template pack lacks evidence, as no interviewees committed to purchasing.

kill_criteria.text: No clear demand for a paid solution exists.
kill_criteria.evidence: Interview findings show that no clear demand for a paid solution was observed, and some interviewees have expressed no interest in paying for a template.

kill_criteria.text: Competitors offer free or low-cost alternatives that make the paid solution unattractive.
The founder lacks the skills to build the template pack effectively.

would_change_mind: Evidence that freelance designers are willing to pay USD 100 for a bilingual template pack.
Evidence that the founder can build the template pack effectively and efficiently.
Evidence that the market demand for a paid solution is clear and substantial.
